Mỹ Xuân được biết đến là khu công nghiệp.en: America Chun is known as the industrial district of the southern point economic region, which is the trading ground of many areas, including Hanoi, located along Route 51 and near the economic centres such as Ho Chi Minh City, China, Hong Kong Oil, Fuji... the economy here is also very developed.
Mỹ Xuân được biết đến là khu công nghiệp.zh: 美国 春被称为南点经济区的工业区,是包括河内在内的许多地区的交易场所,位于中国胡志明市沿线,临近经济中心如胡志明市,香港石油,富士...... 这里的经济也非常发达.

Ngoài ra, thời gian vận chuyển sẽ được n.en: Additionally, the shipping time will be specified at the contract via the previous company survey. So the customer can rest assured that the delivery rate at Liu Li is always quick and accurate.
Ngoài ra, thời gian vận chuyển sẽ được n.zh: 此外,合同将通过以前的公司调查具体规定运输时间。 因此顾客可以放心,刘力的交货率总是迅速准确的.

Nhu cầu gửi hàng được xem là một trong n.en: The demand for delivery was considered one of the important needs, which were used extensively in the Hanoi region. In it, the need to send goods from Hanoi to neighboring areas is increasingly popular, and KCN American Spring B1 - Conac & Ocean is one of the receivers from Hanoi with large numbers in recent times.
Nhu cầu gửi hàng được xem là một trong n.zh: 交货需求被认为是河内地区广泛使用的重要需求之一。 其中,从河内向邻近地区送货的需求越来越受欢迎,而KCN美洲之春B1 - Conac & Ocean是近代大量从河内送货的接收者之一.

Như đã đề cập thì hiện nay, với nhu cầu.en: As mentioned earlier, with the demand for transportation too large, the arrival of numerous transport units was carried along. But the important thing to have of a transport unit is the prestige and quality of services. Thus, in this area, Liu Load was born and was able to meet the need most fully.
Như đã đề cập thì hiện nay, với nhu cầu.zh: 如前所述,由于对运输的需求太大,许多运输单位的抵达也随之而来。 但拥有运输单位的重要内容是服务的威望和质量. 因此,在这方面,刘洛德诞生,能够最充分地满足需要。

Nơi đây có hệ thống giao thông phát triể.en: It has developed traffic systems, especially that the road traffic system has always been heavily sheltered in renovations, regular constructions. In addition, the water traffic system and the air traffic here are also very heavily housed.
Nơi đây có hệ thống giao thông phát triể.zh: 它发展了交通系统,特别是道路交通系统在翻新,常规建设中始终被大量庇护. 此外,这里的水上交通系统和空中交通也居住着非常繁多的地方.

Quy định trong hợp đồng sẽ được tuân thủ.en: The rules in the contract will be followed and carried out strictly ensure the quality of the service is optimum.
Quy định trong hợp đồng sẽ được tuân thủ.zh: 合同中的规则将得到遵守和执行,严格确保服务质量的最佳。

Theo dự đoán, đây sẽ là nơi phát triển c.en: It is expected that this will be the development of the new urban community in present-year Fuji that a lot of investors have concentrated here for economic growth. Not only that, lying next to the Border Line and the Oil of War is also a feature of investment in the area.
Theo dự đoán, đây sẽ là nơi phát triển c.zh: 预计这将是许多投资者为经济增长而集中到这里的富士新城社区的发展. 不仅如此,位于边境线和战争石油旁边也是该地区投资的一个特征.

Tiếp theo, sự minh bạch, rõ ràng luôn đư.en: Then, transparency, clearly always being concerned, should be the information on services, commitment, costs are all highlighted at the contract so that the customer feels most secure.
Tiếp theo, sự minh bạch, rõ ràng luôn đư.zh: 因此,透明度显然始终是值得关注的,在合同中应强调服务、承诺和费用,以便客户感到最安全。

Tuy nhiên, trước hàng loạt các đơn vị gi.en: However, it is difficult to find suitable units in the market before a mass of delivery units. So how do we pick the right unit?
Tuy nhiên, trước hàng loạt các đơn vị gi.zh: 但是,在大批交付单位之前,很难在市场上找到合适的单位. 那么,我们如何选择正确的单位?
